mapper.sql: id, user_id, available_points, total_earned_points, total_used_points, version, create_time, update_time
mapper.update: UPDATE user_points SET available_points = available_points + #{pointsChange}, total_earned_points = total_earned_points + #{incomeDelta}, total_used_points = total_used_points + #{usedDelta}, version = version + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND version = #{version} AND available_points + #{pointsChange} >= 0
mapper.select: SELECT @rank_num := @rank_num + 1 AS ranking, sorted.user_id, sorted.username, sorted.display_name, sorted.available_points, sorted.total_earned_points FROM ( SELECT up.user_id, su.username, su.display_name, up.available_points, up.total_earned_points FROM user_points up LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON up.user_id = su.user_id ORDER BY up.total_earned_points DESC, up.update_time ASC ) sorted CROSS JOIN (SELECT @rank_num := 0) r

SELECT ranked.ranking, ranked.user_id, ranked.username, ranked.display_name, ranked.available_points, ranked.total_earned_points FROM ( SELECT @rank_num := @rank_num + 1 AS ranking, sorted.user_id, sorted.username, sorted.display_name, sorted.available_points, sorted.total_earned_points FROM ( SELECT up_inner.user_id, su_inner.username, su_inner.display_name, up_inner.available_points, up_inner.total_earned_points, up_inner.update_time FROM user_points up_inner LEFT JOIN sys_user su_inner ON up_inner.user_id = su_inner.user_id ORDER BY up_inner.total_earned_points DESC, up_inner.update_time ASC ) sorted CROSS JOIN (SELECT @rank_num := 0) r ) ranked WHERE ranked.user_id = #{userId}
